WITH at_risk_users AS (
    SELECT 
        ri.retreg AS user_id,
        f.userregistry AS fan_id,
        f.nicklabel AS nickname,
        f.regmoment AS registration_date,
        f.tierstep AS tier,
        f.ptsval AS points,
        f.statustag AS status,
        f.personal_attributes AS demographics,
        ri.churnflag AS churn_risk,
        CASE 
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'None' THEN 0
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS churn_risk_numeric,
        CASE 
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'High' THEN 'Severe'
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'Medium' THEN 'Medium'
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'Low' THEN 'Low'
            ELSE 'None'
        END AS enhanced_churn_risk
    FROM 
        retentionandinfluence ri
    JOIN 
        fans f ON ri.retainengagepivot = f.userregistry
    WHERE 
        ri.churnflag IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Low')
)
SELECT * INTO at_risk_users_storage FROM at_risk_users;

UPDATE retentionandinfluence ri
SET churnflag = CASE 
    WHEN aru.enhanced_churn_risk = 'Severe' THEN 'High'
    WHEN aru.enhanced_churn_risk = 'Medium' THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN aru.enhanced_churn_risk = 'Low' THEN 'Low'
    ELSE 'None'
END
FROM at_risk_users aru
WHERE ri.retreg = aru.user_id;
